name: Admiral Lamora
summary: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz sends you after Admiral Lamora, who sails on an Eastsea boat northeast of his position. Lamora’s loot could help Whizzbuzz recover some of what the plundering cost him.

sections.title: Whizzbuzz's Losses
sections.body: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz wants Admiral Lamora dead and his loot returned. Lamora is aboard one of the Eastsea’s boats northeast of Whizzbuzz. You are to find which boat he uses and where he keeps his plunder. If it is locked away, Whizzbuzz suspects Lamora carries the key.

faq.q: Who is sending me after Admiral Lamora?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz sends you after Admiral Lamora and asks you to bring back Lamora’s loot.
Lamora is aboard one of the Eastsea’s boats northeast of Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

faq.q: Why does Whizzbuzz want Lamora dead?
faq.answer: Whizzbuzz says Lamora’s plundering has cost him a fortune, and he wants to recover some of his losses.

faq.q: What does Whizzbuzz want from Lamora?
faq.answer: Whizzbuzz wants Lamora dead and his loot brought back. He suspects Lamora carries the key if the stash is locked.
Whizzbuzz says he was unsure you would survive meeting Lamora, then offers to do you a favor and says he may call on you again.
